title: Head of Integrated Media SCG
description:
Your Tasks 
 As a head of integrated media, your main responsibility will be to develop and implement integrated media plan considering traditional and digital media and ensure guidelines and frameworks are embedded.
 You will work very closely with the rest of the marketing team, to ensure an integrated view of media.
 This role will be responsible to: translate new consumer insights per category into an activation media planning, prioritize touchpoints based on audiences and jobs to be done, have a combined touchpoint planning and reorganize activation sequencing and synchronization (Influencers, Precision Marketings, TV, E-comm).
 You will also have a key responsibilities on measurement tools (incl. MMM and Social Listening) to proactively feed business insights to Marketing teams and optimize media spend across channels.
 Develop and implement integrated media strategies that align with overall marketing objectives.
 Guide and coordinate marketers to establish best-in-class Media Communication, including Media Planning, excellence in execution, digital media automation, new ways of working and execution with excellence in channels and new media opportunities.
 Oversee the development of cohesive media plans across various channels, including traditional, digital, social, influencers and emerging media platforms.
 With the local media planner and PI lead, ensure the role of influencers and content creators is clearly defined for each campaign.
 Ensure seamless integration with and between other marketing functions such as creative, content, influencers and analytics.
 Drive cross-functional projects in the area of Integrated Media Communications e.g. reporting, total brand reach, effectiveness measurement (platforms, audiences, creative), content development (playbook and content creators) and cross-functional alignment for full funnel campaigns.
 Coordinate media related topics with Marketing teams, Traditional media, Precision Influencer leads, as well as agency and technology partners.
 Co-develop NIVEA annual business plan.
 Own Measurement tools (incl. MMM and Social Listening) to proactively feed business insights to Marketing teams and optimize media spend across channels
 Lead campaign debrief meetings with Marketing team to capture learnings from previous campaigns, and plan for future efforts.
 Share learnings with other Heads of Media .
 Develop trainings and materials to upskill media community.
 Act as the singular point of contact for Media questions.
 Agencies
 Secure Media and creative agencies pitch / annual negotiation in coordination with Global and Regional Procurement.
 Coordination with Global and Regional Procurement on agency audits, feedback and evaluation.
 Leading meetings between agencies and the Marketing team, planning processes, delegating development and execution.
 Comprehensive control of the media budget in conjunction with brand teams
Your Profile 
 • Commercial, Civil, and Industrial Engineers, with at least 3 years of experience as Digital Manager (or similar) in consumer goods companies.
 • Experience in using Measurement tools for data-driven marketing.
 • High capacity for analysis, proactivity, creativity, innovation, and leadership.
 • With experience in Project Management and fluent in English language.
 • +8 years on-hand experience in traditional and digital media planning.
 • Experience owning and optimizing budget across multiple teams.
 • Strong project management skills (e.g., building & rigorously tracking work plan).
 • Significant experience communicating technical material to range of audiences, including brands, corporate leadership, technology partners, and agencies;
 • Excellent presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
 • Strong numerical, strategic, logical thinking.
Caring for skin means caring for people.   
It all started with a pharmacist and a dream almost 140 years ago. Today, Beiersdorf is a global company with iconic brands — Coppertone, Aquaphor, Eucerin and NIVEA — focused on providing innovative, clinically-proven and safe skin and sun care solutions to more than 500 million consumers in over 200 countries — making people feel comfortable in their own skin.   
 At Beiersdorf, we care beyond skin. We care for people — our employees, our customers, our consumers and our communities — and our planet. We know that diversity of thought, backgrounds, experience and perspective enriches our culture and fosters innovation and ingenuity.  We know that responsibly-sourced, sustainable products and packaging make for a more sustainable future. And we know that when your skin feels better, you feel better.   
A welcoming workplace that offers personal and professional growth for all individuals.
At Beiersdorf, you’ll find: 
A welcoming workplace that fosters diversity, inclusion and belonging where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported
Nimble teams that enjoy challenging work and the ability to make an impact
A dynamic community of life-long learners that values acumen, aptitude and the ability to learn as well as hard skills and established expertise
A purpose-led company that cares about your personal and professional development with the right balance of structure and flexibility to thrive
A collaborative culture that leads with care, trust, simplicity, and courage
